question: Estimate the annual revenue from FASTag toll collection in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total FASTag toll collection across all toll plazas? Yes.
NHAI tolls + state toll roads + private (concession) operators? All FASTag-enabled.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Vehicles tolled per day × avg toll × days.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total daily FASTag transactions (NPCI data): ~1.1-1.2 crore transactions/day (FY26).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Note: this is gross toll collected; not all goes to NHAI — concessionaires (private operators) keep ~70% of their plaza collections.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Average toll per transaction (blended cars + commercial vehicles)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~₹55,000 Cr annual FASTag toll collection in India.
this is gross toll collected; not all goes to NHAI — concessionaires (private operators) keep ~70% of their plaza collections.

calculationFlow: Total daily FASTag transactions (NPCI data): ~1.1-1.2 crore transactions/day (FY26).
Average toll per transaction (blended cars + commercial vehicles): ~₹120-140 (commercial vehicles pay 2-7x cars).
Round: ~₹55,000 Cr annual FASTag toll collection in India.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~₹55,000 Cr annual FASTag toll collection in India.
